cmd:
cat > /tmp/pm.py <<"EOF"
import json, time, sys, urllib.request
sys.path.insert(0,"/opt/trading-bot/positions")
import pos
ps=json.load(open("/opt/trading-bot/positions/positions.json"))
p=ps[0]
print({k:p.get(k) for k in ("id","sym","side","entry","stop0","stop","tp","status","reason","exit","net_pct","r_mult","pnl_usd","mfe_pct","mae_pct","armed","t_in","t_out")})
print("in",pos.tstr(p["t_in"]),"out",pos.tstr(p["t_out"]) if p.get("t_out") else None)
d=pos.kl(p["sym"],"15m",1000,(p["t_in"]//900000)*900000-4*900000)
print("15m candles from 1h before entry (UTC  o h l c):")
for k in d:
    t=int(k[0]); mark=" <-IN" if t<=p["t_in"]<t+900000 else (" <-OUT" if p.get("t_out") and t<=p["t_out"]-1<t+900000 else "")
    print(pos.tstr(t),k[1],k[2],k[3],k[4],mark)
EOF
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/pm.py 2>&1 | tail -70
